sites.csv.gz.hostname: Lowercase normalized DNS name ending in .gov.np, wildcard prefix stripped.
sites.csv.gz.apex_hostname: Registrable .gov.np name: the hostname itself when it has three labels, else its last three labels.
sites.csv.gz.subdomain: Everything left of the apex; empty for an apex hostname.
sites.csv.gz.in_observed_sample: 'true' when the hostname entered the deterministic observation sample.
sites.csv.gz.discovered_via: Semicolon-joined discovery tags: crtsh, tls_sample, attribution, or a combination; records where the name was first seen.

roster.csv.gz.province_id: Stable source identifier, kept as a string.
roster.csv.gz.province: Province display name as delivered by the OAG API.
roster.csv.gz.district_id: Stable source identifier, kept as a string.
roster.csv.gz.district: District display name as delivered by the OAG API.
roster.csv.gz.municipality_id: Stable local-level identifier, kept as a string.
roster.csv.gz.name: Local-level display name; capitalization and wording are unchanged.
roster.csv.gz.normalized_name: Whitespace-collapsed, Unicode case-folded name used for exact matching.

attribution.csv.gz.hostname: Attributed hostname, or empty when no hostname could be established.
attribution.csv.gz.local_level_id: Canonical roster municipality_id the hostname maps to.
attribution.csv.gz.method: Attribution rule: localbody_directory, wikidata_p856, ct_hostname_slug, osm_website, or manual; empty when unresolved.
attribution.csv.gz.confidence: high, medium, low, or none, following the strength of the accepted evidence.
attribution.csv.gz.evidence_url: The exact source URL the decision is based on, or empty when unresolved.
attribution.csv.gz.evidence_note: Human-readable statement of the evidence, including the source row or item and any disambiguation applied.
attribution.csv.gz.decided_at: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the attribution decision was made.

hosting.csv.gz.confidence: high, medium, or low, following the classification evidence.

dns_mail.csv.gz.a_count: Number of A answers returned through DNS-over-HTTPS.
dns_mail.csv.gz.mx_present: 'true' when at least one MX answer was returned.
dns_mail.csv.gz.spf_status: absent, present, or unknown, derived from TXT evidence and query errors.

http_headers.csv.gz.hostname: Hostname parsed from the requested URL.
http_headers.csv.gz.response_status: HTTP status code, if a response was received.
http_headers.csv.gz.has_content_security_policy: 'true' when a non-empty Content-Security-Policy header was present.
http_headers.csv.gz.has_strict_transport_security: 'true' when a non-empty Strict-Transport-Security header was present.
http_headers.csv.gz.has_x_content_type_options: 'true' when a non-empty X-Content-Type-Options header was present.
http_headers.csv.gz.has_x_frame_options: 'true' when a non-empty X-Frame-Options header was present.
http_headers.csv.gz.has_referrer_policy: 'true' when a non-empty Referrer-Policy header was present.
http_headers.csv.gz.has_permissions_policy: 'true' when a non-empty Permissions-Policy header was present.
http_headers.csv.gz.missing_header_count: Count of the six audited headers not present.

tls.csv.gz.validity: Certificate validity result under system CA and hostname verification.
tls.csv.gz.subject: Decoded certificate subject.

third_party_scripts.csv.gz.script_url: Referenced script URL; empty when the page was not fetched.
third_party_scripts.csv.gz.category: first_party, analytics, advertising, cdn, embedded, or other.
third_party_scripts.csv.gz.script_count: Total scripts referenced by the page as recorded in the observation.
third_party_scripts.csv.gz.third_party_script_count: Scripts not served by the audited site.

robots.csv.gz.accessible: 'true' when robots.txt returned 200 on the same HTTPS host.

entities.csv.gz.apex_hostname: Registrable .gov.np name: the hostname itself when it has three labels, else its last three labels.
entities.csv.gz.owner_label: Display name of the owning organization as named by the source, or empty when unknown.
entities.csv.gz.owner_type: Controlled owner type: local_level, province, ministry, department_or_office, court, commission, security_force, university_or_school, hospital_or_health, corporation_or_authority, park_or_heritage, media_or_culture, other_government, or unknown.
entities.csv.gz.local_level_id: Canonical roster municipality_id when the owner is a local level; empty otherwise.
entities.csv.gz.district: District named by the source, when any.
entities.csv.gz.qid: Wikidata item id the classification came from, when any.
entities.csv.gz.method: attribution:<method> for an inherited local-level link, wikidata_p856, manual, or unclassified.
entities.csv.gz.confidence: high, medium, low, or none, following the strength of the source description.
entities.csv.gz.evidence_url: The exact source URL the classification is based on, or empty when unclassified.
entities.csv.gz.evidence_note: Human-readable statement of the evidence or the reason the apex is unclassified.
